summary: Returns the element with the smallest value in the collection
description:
The .min() function returns the element with the smallest value in the collection (the first element of the collection as it would be sorted in ascending order using the .sort() function).

This function does not modify the original collection.

If the collection contains different types of values, they will be sorted according to the 4D ordering principles and the .min() function will return the minimum value within the first element type in the type list order.

If the collection contains objects, pass the propertyPath parameter to indicate the object property whose minimum value you want to get.

If the collection is empty, .min() returns Undefined.

params.name: propertyPath
params.description: Object property path to be used for evaluation
